in_sanskrit.name: Jilla
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: जिल्ला (Jilla) is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'jilla' which means 'beauty' or 'grace'. It is a feminine name and is often used in Hindu mythology to denote the divine feminine or the goddess of beauty and grace.

in_hindi.name: जिल्ला
in_hindi.long_meaning: जिल्ला (Jilla) is a Hindi name which translates to 'beautiful or graceful'. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jilla' which has the same meaning. It is a feminine name and is often used to denote a woman who is beautiful and graceful in her demeanor.

in_tamil.name: ஜில்லா
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஜில்லா (Jilla) is a Tamil name meaning 'Beautiful or Graceful'. It is derived from the Tamil word 'jill' which means 'beauty' or 'grace'. The name is often given to girls who are believed to possess these qualities.

in_telugu.name: Jilla
in_telugu.long_meaning: Jilla ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jal' meaning water, Jilla signifies gentle waves. In Hindu mythology, Jilla is associated with the goddess Saraswati, the embodiment of knowledge and wisdom.
